values.note: 75 sites, 'most will accommodate all types of recreational vehicles'; each has a picnic table, charcoal grill and fire pit. Most have electric and cable TV hookups with access to water. No tent camping except Rhythm and Roots weekend.

sites.source: https://bristolva.gov/149/Campground ('The campground offers 75 camping sites and most will accommodate all types of recreational vehicles', 'Most sites have electrical and cable hookup with access to water', 'NO TENT CAMPING PERMITTED'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Two comfort stations with hot showers; one dump station; Wi-Fi reaches most sites.

facilities.source: https://bristolva.gov/149/Campground ('plus 2 shower houses & 1 dump station', 'two comfort stations, complete with hot showers and a sewage dump station', 'Most sites are Wi-Fi accessible along with cable hookups!'), read 2026-10-21

season.source: https://bristolva.gov/149/Campground ('CAMPGROUND IS OPEN MID-APRIL thru OCTOBER'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Stays limited to 5 days, with a possible 5-day extension on approval. Check-in 3-8 p.m. weekdays, 10 a.m.-7:30 p.m. weekends; the registering party must show a photo driver's license with proof of current residence.

booking.source: https://bristolva.gov/149/Campground ('Length of stay limited to 5 days (possible 5 day re-up upon approval)', 'Check in time is 3:00pm - 8:00pm weekday/10am -7:30pm Sat. & Sun.'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: $20 a night including water, electric, cable TV and Wi-Fi; $27 a night over Rhythm and Roots weekend. The city's page carries no date; read 2026-10-21 while it says the campground is open.

fees.source: https://bristolva.gov/149/Campground ('RATES: $20.00/night Rhythm and Roots Weekend $27.00/night includes water, electric, cable tv and Wi-Fi'), read 2026-10-21

summary: City page confirms 75 sites, no tents; added $20/night ($27 Rhythm and Roots weekend; page undated), showers/dump/Wi-Fi, season mid-April through October, 5-day stay limit. Not stated: amperage (50A left derived), water at the site ('access to water'), whether sites are first-come (FCFS left derived).
